verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ שְׁנָתַ֣יִם יָמִ֑ים וּפַרְעֹ֣ה חֹלֵ֔ם וְהִנֵּ֖ה עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־ הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ šə·nā·ṯa·yim yā·mîm ū·p̄ar·‘ōh ḥō·lêm wə·hin·nêh ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- hay·’ōr
verses.literal: After two full years . . . had passed Pharaoh had a dream . . . He was standing beside the Nile
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU que, ao fim de dois anos inteiros, Faraó sonhou, e eis que estava em pé junto ao rio.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־ הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת יְפ֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וּבְרִיאֹ֣ת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh min- hay·’ōr ‘ō·lōṯ še·ḇa‘ pā·rō·wṯ yə·p̄ō·wṯ mar·’eh ū·ḇə·rî·’ōṯ bā·śār wat·tir·‘e·nāh bā·’ā·ḥū
verses.literal: when seven cows sleek . . . and well-fed . . . came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds
verses.literalPt: E eis que subiam do rio sete vacas, formosas à vista e gordas de carne, e pastavam no prado.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶׁ֧בַע פָּר֣וֹת אֲחֵר֗וֹת עֹל֤וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן֙ מִן־ הַיְאֹ֔ר רָע֥וֹת מַרְאֶ֖ה וְדַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֛דְנָה אֵ֥צֶל הַפָּר֖וֹת עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ pā·rō·wṯ ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ ‘ō·lō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hen min- hay·’ōr rā·‘ō·wṯ mar·’eh wə·ḏaq·qō·wṯ bā·śār wat·ta·‘ă·mō·ḏə·nāh ’ê·ṣel hap·pā·rō·wṯ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: After them seven other cows sickly . . . and thin . . . came up from the Nile and stood beside the well-fed cows on the bank of the river
verses.literalPt: E eis que subiam do rio após elas outras sete vacas, feias à vista e magras de carne; e paravam junto às outras vacas na praia do rio.

verses.original: וַתֹּאכַ֣לְנָה הַפָּר֗וֹת רָע֤וֹת הַמַּרְאֶה֙ וְדַקֹּ֣ת הַבָּשָׂ֔ר אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַפָּר֔וֹת יְפֹ֥ת הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְהַבְּרִיאֹ֑ת וַיִּיקַ֖ץ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·ḵal·nāh hap·pā·rō·wṯ rā·‘ō·wṯ ham·mar·’eh wə·ḏaq·qōṯ hab·bā·śār ’êṯ še·ḇa‘ hap·pā·rō·wṯ yə·p̄ōṯ ham·mar·’eh wə·hab·bə·rî·’ōṯ way·yî·qaṣ par·‘ōh
verses.literal: And the cows that were sickly . . . and thin . . . devoured the seven sleek . . . well-fed cows Then Pharaoh woke up
verses.literalPt: E as vacas feias à vista e magras de carne, comiam as sete vacas formosas à vista e gordas. Então acordou Faraó.

verses.original: וַיִּישָׁ֕ן וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֖ם שֵׁנִ֑ית וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹל֛וֹת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד בְּרִיא֥וֹת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·šān way·ya·ḥă·lōm šê·nîṯ wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm ‘ō·lō·wṯ bə·qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ bə·rî·’ō·wṯ wə·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: but he fell back asleep and dreamed a second time . . . Seven heads of grain plump and ripe came up on one stalk
verses.literalPt: Depois dormiu e sonhou outra vez, e eis que brotavam de um mesmo pé sete espigas cheias e boas.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים דַּקּ֖וֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹ֣ת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm daq·qō·wṯ ū·šə·ḏū·p̄ōṯ qā·ḏîm ṣō·mə·ḥō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hen
verses.literal: After them seven other heads of grain sprouted thin and scorched by the east wind
verses.literalPt: E eis que sete espigas miúdas, e queimadas do vento oriental, brotavam após elas.

verses.original: וַתִּבְלַ֙עְנָה֙ הַשִּׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקּ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת שֶׁ֣בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִ֔ים הַבְּרִיא֖וֹת וְהַמְּלֵא֑וֹת וַיִּיקַ֥ץ פַּרְעֹ֖ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֲלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḇ·la‘·nāh haš·šib·bo·lîm had·daq·qō·wṯ ’êṯ še·ḇa‘ haš·šib·bo·lîm hab·bə·rî·’ō·wṯ wə·ham·mə·lê·’ō·wṯ way·yî·qaṣ par·‘ōh wə·hin·nêh ḥă·lō·wm
verses.literal: And the thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven plump ripe ones Then Pharaoh awoke and realized it was a dream
verses.literalPt: E as espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas grandes e cheias. Então acordou Faraó, e eis que era um sonho.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ וַתִּפָּ֣עֶם רוּח֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־ כָּל־ חַרְטֻמֵּ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֲכָמֶ֑יהָ וַיְסַפֵּ֨ר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לָהֶם֙ אֶת־ חֲלֹמ֔וֹ וְאֵין־ פּוֹתֵ֥ר אוֹתָ֖ם לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇab·bō·qer wat·tip·pā·‘em rū·ḥōw way·yiš·laḥ way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- kāl- ḥar·ṭum·mê miṣ·ra·yim wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥă·ḵā·me·hā way·sap·pêr par·‘ōh lā·hem ’eṯ- ḥă·lō·mōw wə·’ên- pō·w·ṯêr ’ō·w·ṯām lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: In the morning . . . his spirit was troubled so he summoned . . . all the magicians and wise men of Egypt Pharaoh told them his dreams but no one could interpret them for him
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que pela manhã o seu espírito perturbou-se, e enviou e chamou todos os adivinhadores do Egito, e todos os seus sábios; e Faraó contou-lhes os seus sonhos, mas ninguém havia que lhos interpretasse.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַמַּשְׁקִ֔ים אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֶת־ חֲטָאַ֕י אֲנִ֖י מַזְכִּ֥יר הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr śar ham·maš·qîm ’eṯ- par·‘ōh lê·mōr ’eṯ- ḥă·ṭā·’ay ’ă·nî maz·kîr hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh . . . Today I recall my failures
verses.literalPt: Então falou o copeiro-mor a Faraó, dizendo: Das minhas ofensas me lembro hoje:

verses.original: פַּרְעֹ֖ה קָצַ֣ף עַל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתִ֜י בְּמִשְׁמַ֗ר בֵּ֚ית שַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים אֹתִ֕י וְאֵ֖ת שַׂ֥ר הָאֹפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: par·‘ōh qā·ṣap̄ ‘al- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯî bə·miš·mar bêṯ śar haṭ·ṭab·bā·ḥîm ’ō·ṯî wə·’êṯ śar hā·’ō·p̄îm
verses.literal: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants and he put me and the chief baker in the custody . . . of the captain of the guard
verses.literalPt: Estando Faraó muito indignado contra os seus servos, e pondo-me sob prisão na casa do capitão da guarda, a mim e ao padeiro-mor,

verses.original: וַנַּֽחַלְמָ֥ה חֲל֛וֹם בְּלַ֥יְלָה אֶחָ֖ד אֲנִ֣י וָה֑וּא אִ֛ישׁ כְּפִתְר֥וֹן חֲלֹמ֖וֹ חָלָֽמְנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·na·ḥal·māh ḥă·lō·wm bə·lay·lāh ’e·ḥāḏ ’ă·nî wā·hū ’îš kə·p̄iṯ·rō·wn ḥă·lō·mōw ḥā·lā·mə·nū
verses.literal: One night both the chief baker and I had dreams . . . and each dream . . . had its own meaning
verses.literalPt: Então tivemos um sonho na mesma noite, eu e ele; sonhamos, cada um conforme a interpretação do seu sonho.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ם אִתָּ֜נוּ נַ֣עַר עִבְרִ֗י עֶ֚בֶד לְשַׂ֣ר הַטַּבָּחִ֔ים וַנְּ֨סַפֶּר־ ל֔וֹ וַיִּפְתָּר־ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ חֲלֹמֹתֵ֑ינוּ אִ֥ישׁ כַּחֲלֹמ֖וֹ פָּתָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šām ’it·tā·nū na·‘ar ‘iḇ·rî ‘e·ḇeḏ lə·śar haṭ·ṭab·bā·ḥîm wan·nə·sap·per- lō way·yip̄·tār- lā·nū ’eṯ- ḥă·lō·mō·ṯê·nū ’îš ka·ḥă·lō·mōw pā·ṯār
verses.literal: Now a young Hebrew was there with us a servant of the captain of the guard We told him our dreams and he interpreted them for us individually . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E estava ali conosco um jovem hebreu, servo do capitão da guarda, e contamos-lhe os nossos sonhos e ele no-los interpretou, a cada um conforme o seu sonho.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּֽתַר־ לָ֖נוּ כֵּ֣ן הָיָ֑ה אֹתִ֛י הֵשִׁ֥יב עַל־ כַּנִּ֖י וְאֹת֥וֹ תָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer pā·ṯar- lā·nū kên hā·yāh ’ō·ṯî hê·šîḇ ‘al- kan·nî wə·’ō·ṯōw ṯā·lāh
verses.literal: And it happened to us just as he had interpreted . . . . . . I was restored to my position and the other man was hanged
verses.literalPt: E como ele nos interpretou, assim aconteceu; a mim me foi restituído o meu cargo, e ele foi enforcado.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח פַּרְעֹה֙ וַיִּקְרָ֣א אֶת־ יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיְרִיצֻ֖הוּ מִן־ הַבּ֑וֹר וַיְגַלַּח֙ וַיְחַלֵּ֣ף שִׂמְלֹתָ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖א אֶל־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ par·‘ōh way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄ way·rî·ṣu·hū min- hab·bō·wr way·ḡal·laḥ way·ḥal·lêp̄ śim·lō·ṯāw way·yā·ḇō ’el- par·‘ōh
verses.literal: So Pharaoh sent for . . . Joseph who was quickly brought out of the dungeon After he had shaved and changed his clothes he went in before Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: Então mandou Faraó chamar a José, e o fizeram sair logo do cárcere; e barbeou-se e mudou as suas roupas e apresentou-se a Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף חֲל֣וֹם חָלַ֔מְתִּי וּפֹתֵ֖ר אֵ֣ין אֹת֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֗י שָׁמַ֤עְתִּי עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר תִּשְׁמַ֥ע חֲל֖וֹם לִפְתֹּ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ḥă·lō·wm ḥā·lam·tî ū·p̄ō·ṯêr ’ên ’ō·ṯōw wa·’ă·nî šā·ma‘·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā lê·mōr tiš·ma‘ ḥă·lō·wm lip̄·tōr ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Pharaoh said to Joseph I had a dream . . . and no one can interpret it But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it
verses.literalPt: E Faraó disse a José: Eu tive um sonho, e ninguém há que o interprete; mas de ti ouvi dizer que quando ouves um sonho o interpretas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יוֹסֵ֧ף אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֛ה לֵאמֹ֖ר בִּלְעָדָ֑י אֱלֹהִ֕ים יַעֲנֶ֖ה אֶת־ שְׁל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- par·‘ōh lê·mōr bil·‘ā·ḏāy ’ĕ·lō·hîm ya·‘ă·neh ’eṯ- šə·lō·wm par·‘ōh
verses.literal: I myself cannot do it Joseph replied . . . . . . but God will give Pharaoh a sound answer
verses.literalPt: E respondeu José a Faraó, dizendo: Isso não está em mim; Deus dará resposta de paz a Faraó.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף בַּחֲלֹמִ֕י הִנְנִ֥י עֹמֵ֖ד עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיְאֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ba·ḥă·lō·mî hin·nî ‘ō·mêḏ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·’ōr
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph In my dream . . . I was standing on the bank of the Nile
verses.literalPt: Então disse Faraó a José: Eis que em meu sonho estava eu em pé na margem do rio,

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה מִן־ הַיְאֹ֗ר עֹלֹת֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פָּר֔וֹת בְּרִיא֥וֹת בָּשָׂ֖ר וִיפֹ֣ת תֹּ֑אַר וַתִּרְעֶ֖ינָה בָּאָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh min- hay·’ōr ‘ō·lōṯ še·ḇa‘ pā·rō·wṯ bə·rî·’ō·wṯ bā·śār wî·p̄ōṯ tō·’ar wat·tir·‘e·nāh bā·’ā·ḥū
verses.literal: when seven cows well-fed . . . and sleek . . . came up from the river and began to graze among the reeds
verses.literalPt: E eis que subiam do rio sete vacas gordas de carne e formosas à vista, e pastavam no prado.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה שֶֽׁבַע־ פָּר֤וֹת אֲחֵרוֹת֙ עֹל֣וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן דַּלּ֨וֹת וְרָע֥וֹת תֹּ֛אַר מְאֹ֖ד וְרַקּ֣וֹת בָּשָׂ֑ר לֹֽא־ רָאִ֧יתִי כָהֵ֛נָּה בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לָרֹֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘- pā·rō·wṯ ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ ‘ō·lō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hen dal·lō·wṯ wə·rā·‘ō·wṯ tō·’ar mə·’ōḏ wə·raq·qō·wṯ bā·śār lō- rā·’î·ṯî ḵā·hên·nāh bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lā·rō·a‘
verses.literal: After them . . . seven other cows sickly ugly . . . and thin . . . came up I have never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E eis que outras sete vacas subiam após estas, muito feias à vista e magras de carne; não tenho visto outras tais, quanto à fealdade, em toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַתֹּאכַ֙לְנָה֙ הַפָּר֔וֹת הָרַקּ֖וֹת וְהָרָע֑וֹת אֵ֣ת שֶׁ֧בַע הַפָּר֛וֹת הָרִאשֹׁנ֖וֹת הַבְּרִיאֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·ḵal·nāh hap·pā·rō·wṯ hā·raq·qō·wṯ wə·hā·rā·‘ō·wṯ ’êṯ še·ḇa‘ hap·pā·rō·wṯ hā·ri·šō·nō·wṯ hab·bə·rî·’ōṯ
verses.literal: Then the thin ugly cows devoured the seven well-fed cows that were there first
verses.literalPt: E as vacas magras e feias comiam as primeiras sete vacas gordas;

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֣אנָה אֶל־ קִרְבֶּ֗נָה וְלֹ֤א נוֹדַע֙ כִּי־ בָ֣אוּ אֶל־ קִרְבֶּ֔נָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֣ן רַ֔ע כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּתְּחִלָּ֑ה וָאִיקָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·nāh ’el- qir·be·nāh wə·lō nō·w·ḏa‘ kî- ḇā·’ū ’el- qir·be·nāh ū·mar·’ê·hen ra‘ ka·’ă·šer bat·tə·ḥil·lāh wā·’î·qāṣ
verses.literal: When they had devoured . . . them, however no one could tell that they had done so . . . . . . their appearance was as ugly as it had been before Then I awoke
verses.literalPt: E entravam em suas entranhas, mas não se conhecia que houvessem entrado; porque o seu parecer era feio como no princípio. Então acordei.

verses.original: וָאֵ֖רֶא בַּחֲלֹמִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֗ים עֹלֹ֛ת בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד מְלֵאֹ֥ת וְטֹבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ê·re ba·ḥă·lō·mî wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm ‘ō·lōṯ bə·qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ mə·lê·’ōṯ wə·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: In my dream . . . I also saw seven heads of grain plump and ripe growing on a single stalk
verses.literalPt: Depois vi em meu sonho, e eis que de um mesmo pé subiam sete espigas cheias e boas;

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע שִׁבֳּלִ֔ים צְנֻמ֥וֹת דַּקּ֖וֹת שְׁדֻפ֣וֹת קָדִ֑ים צֹמְח֖וֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šib·bo·lîm ṣə·nu·mō·wṯ daq·qō·wṯ šə·ḏu·p̄ō·wṯ qā·ḏîm ṣō·mə·ḥō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: After them seven other heads of grain sprouted withered thin and scorched by the east wind
verses.literalPt: E eis que sete espigas secas, miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental, brotavam após elas.

verses.original: וַתִּבְלַ֙עְןָ֙ הָשִׁבֳּלִ֣ים הַדַּקֹּ֔ת אֵ֛ת שֶׁ֥בַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִ֖ים הַטֹּב֑וֹת וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֶל־ הַֽחַרְטֻמִּ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין מַגִּ֖יד לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḇ·la‘·nā hå̄·šib·bo·līm had·daq·qōṯ ’êṯ še·ḇa‘ ha·šib·bo·lîm haṭ·ṭō·ḇō·wṯ wā·’ō·mar ’el- ha·ḥar·ṭum·mîm wə·’ên mag·gîḏ lî
verses.literal: And the thin heads of grain swallowed the seven plump ones I told this dream to the magicians but no one could explain it to me
verses.literalPt: E as sete espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas boas. E eu contei isso aos magos, mas ninguém houve que mo interpretasse.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹסֵף֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה חֲל֥וֹם פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶחָ֣ד ה֑וּא אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הִגִּ֥יד לְפַרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·sêp̄ ’el- par·‘ōh ḥă·lō·wm par·‘ōh ’e·ḥāḏ hū ’êṯ ’ă·šer hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·śeh hig·gîḏ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: At this, Joseph said to Pharaoh The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same . . . God has revealed to Pharaoh what He is about to do
verses.literalPt: Então disse José a Faraó: O sonho de Faraó é um só; o que Deus há de fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.

verses.original: שֶׁ֧בַע פָּרֹ֣ת הַטֹּבֹ֗ת שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִּׁבֳּלִים֙ הַטֹּבֹ֔ת שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים הֵ֑נָּה חֲל֖וֹם אֶחָ֥ד הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: še·ḇa‘ pā·rōṯ haṭ·ṭō·ḇōṯ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm hên·nāh wə·še·ḇa‘ haš·šib·bo·lîm haṭ·ṭō·ḇōṯ še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm hên·nāh ḥă·lō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ hū
verses.literal: The seven good cows are seven years . . . and the seven ripe heads of grain are seven years . . . The dreams have the same meaning . . .
verses.literalPt: As sete vacas formosas são sete anos, as sete espigas formosas também são sete anos, o sonho é um só.

verses.original: וְשֶׁ֣בַע הַ֠פָּרוֹת הָֽרַקּ֨וֹת וְהָרָעֹ֜ת הָעֹלֹ֣ת אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְשֶׁ֤בַע הַֽשִׁבֳּלִים֙ הָרֵק֔וֹת שְׁדֻפ֖וֹת הַקָּדִ֑ים יִהְי֕וּ שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י רָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·še·ḇa‘ hap·pā·rō·wṯ hā·raq·qō·wṯ wə·hā·rā·‘ōṯ hā·‘ō·lōṯ ’a·ḥă·rê·hen še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm hên·nāh wə·še·ḇa‘ ha·šib·bo·lîm hā·rê·qō·wṯ šə·ḏu·p̄ō·wṯ haq·qā·ḏîm yih·yū še·ḇa‘ šə·nê rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Moreover, the seven thin ugly cows that came up after them are seven years and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind they are seven years of famine
verses.literalPt: E as sete vacas feias à vista e magras, que subiam depois delas, são sete anos, e as sete espigas miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental, serão sete anos de fome.

verses.original: ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים עֹשֶׂ֖ה הֶרְאָ֥ה אֶת־ פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hū had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’el- par·‘ōh ’ă·šer hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·śeh her·’āh ’eṯ- par·‘ōh
verses.literal: It . . . is just as I said to Pharaoh God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do
verses.literalPt: Esta é a palavra que tenho dito a Faraó; o que Deus há de fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים בָּא֑וֹת שָׂבָ֥ע גָּד֖וֹל בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm bā·’ō·wṯ śā·ḇā‘ gā·ḏō·wl bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Behold seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E eis que vêm sete anos, e haverá grande fartura em toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְ֠קָמוּ שֶׁ֜בַע שְׁנֵ֤י רָעָב֙ אַחֲרֵיהֶ֔ן וְנִשְׁכַּ֥ח כָּל־ הַשָּׂבָ֖ע בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְכִלָּ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·mū še·ḇa‘ šə·nê rā·‘āḇ ’a·ḥă·rê·hen wə·niš·kaḥ kāl- haś·śā·ḇā‘ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·ḵil·lāh hā·rā·‘āḇ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: but seven years of famine will follow them Then all the abundance in the land of Egypt will be forgotten and the famine will devastate the land
verses.literalPt: E depois deles levantar-se-ão sete anos de fome, e toda aquela fartura será esquecida na terra do Egito, e a fome consumirá a terra;

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִוָּדַ֤ע הַשָּׂבָע֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֛י הָרָעָ֥ב הַה֖וּא אַחֲרֵי־ כֵ֑ן כִּֽי־ כָבֵ֥ד ה֖וּא מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yiw·wā·ḏa‘ haś·śā·ḇā‘ bā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ ha·hū ’a·ḥă·rê- ḵên kî- ḵā·ḇêḏ hū mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: The abundance in the land will not be remembered since the famine that follows it will be so severe
verses.literalPt: E não será conhecida a abundância na terra, por causa daquela fome que haverá depois; porquanto será gravíssima.

verses.original: וְעַ֨ל הִשָּׁנ֧וֹת הַחֲל֛וֹם אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה פַּעֲמָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ נָכ֤וֹן הַדָּבָר֙ מֵעִ֣ם הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּמְמַהֵ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לַעֲשֹׂתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al hiš·šā·nō·wṯ ha·ḥă·lō·wm ’el- par·‘ōh pa·‘ă·mā·yim kî- nā·ḵō·wn had·dā·ḇār mê·‘im hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mə·ma·hêr hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm la·‘ă·śō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Moreover because the dream was given to Pharaoh in two versions the matter has been decreed by God and He will carry it out shortly
verses.literalPt: E que o sonho foi repetido duas vezes a Faraó, é porque esta coisa é determinada por Deus, e Deus se apressa em fazê-la.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יֵרֶ֣א פַרְעֹ֔ה אִ֖ישׁ נָב֣וֹן וְחָכָ֑ם וִישִׁיתֵ֖הוּ עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yê·re p̄ar·‘ōh ’îš nā·ḇō·wn wə·ḥā·ḵām wî·šî·ṯê·hū ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now, therefore Pharaoh should look for a discerning and wise man and set him over the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Portanto, Faraó previna-se agora de um homem entendido e sábio, e o ponha sobre a terra do Egito.

verses.original: יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְיַפְקֵ֥ד פְּקִדִ֖ים עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֥י הַשָּׂבָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘ă·śeh p̄ar·‘ōh wə·yap̄·qêḏ pə·qi·ḏîm ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḥim·mêš ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bə·še·ḇa‘ šə·nê haś·śā·ḇā‘
verses.literal: Let Pharaoh take action and appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance
verses.literalPt: Faça isso Faraó e ponha governadores sobre a terra, e tome a quinta parte da terra do Egito nos sete anos de fartura,

verses.original: וְיִקְבְּצ֗וּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹ֙כֶל֙ הַשָּׁנִ֣ים הַטֹּבֹ֔ת הַבָּאֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ־ בָ֞ר תַּ֧חַת יַד־ פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֹ֥כֶל בֶּעָרִ֖ים וְשָׁמָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiq·bə·ṣū ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·ḵel haš·šā·nîm haṭ·ṭō·ḇōṯ hab·bā·’ōṯ hā·’êl·leh wə·yiṣ·bə·rū- ḇār ta·ḥaṯ yaḏ- par·‘ōh ’ō·ḵel be·‘ā·rîm wə·šā·mā·rū
verses.literal: Under the authority of Pharaoh let them collect all the excess food from these good years that they may come and lay up the grain to be preserved as food in the cities
verses.literalPt: E ajuntem toda a comida destes bons anos, que vêm, e amontoem o trigo debaixo da mão de Faraó, para mantimento nas cidades, e o guardem.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה הָאֹ֤כֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן֙ לָאָ֔רֶץ לְשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָרָעָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖יןָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְלֹֽא־ תִכָּרֵ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּרָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh hā·’ō·ḵel lə·p̄iq·qā·ḏō·wn lā·’ā·reṣ lə·še·ḇa‘ šə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ ’ă·šer tih·ye·nā bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·lō- ṯik·kā·rêṯ hā·’ā·reṣ bā·rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: This food will be a reserve for the land during the seven years of famine to come upon the land of Egypt Then the country will not perish in the famine
verses.literalPt: Assim será o mantimento para provimento da terra, para os sete anos de fome, que haverá na terra do Egito; para que a terra não pereça de fome.

verses.original: וַיִּיטַ֥ב הַדָּבָ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·ṭaḇ had·dā·ḇār bə·‘ê·nê p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇə·‘ê·nê kāl- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw
verses.literal: This proposal pleased . . . Pharaoh . . . and all his officials
verses.literalPt: E esta palavra foi boa aos olhos de Faraó, e aos olhos de todos os seus servos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו הֲנִמְצָ֣א כָזֶ֔ה אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw hă·nim·ṣā ḵā·zeh ’îš ’ă·šer rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bōw
verses.literal: So Pharaoh asked . . . them Can we find anyone like this man in whom the Spirit of God abides
verses.literalPt: E disse Faraó a seus servos: Acharíamos um homem como este em quem haja o espírito de Deus?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר פַּרְעֹה֙ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אַחֲרֵ֨י הוֹדִ֧יעַ אֱלֹהִ֛ים אוֹתְךָ֖ אֶת־ כָּל־ זֹ֑את אֵין־ נָב֥וֹן וְחָכָ֖ם כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê hō·w·ḏî·a‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ō·wṯ·ḵā ’eṯ- kāl- zōṯ ’ên- nā·ḇō·wn wə·ḥā·ḵām kā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph Since God - has made all this known to you there is no one as discerning and wise as you
verses.literalPt: Depois disse Faraó a José: Pois que Deus te fez saber tudo isto, ninguém há tão entendido e sábio como tu.

verses.original: אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה עַל־ בֵּיתִ֔י וְעַל־ פִּ֖יךָ יִשַּׁ֣ק כָּל־ עַמִּ֑י רַ֥ק הַכִּסֵּ֖א אֶגְדַּ֥ל מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh tih·yeh ‘al- bê·ṯî wə·‘al- pî·ḵā yiš·šaq kāl- ‘am·mî raq hak·kis·sê ’eḡ·dal mim·me·kā
verses.literal: You shall be in charge of my house . . . and all my people are to obey your commands Only with regard to the throne will I be greater than you
verses.literalPt: Tu estarás sobre a minha casa, e por tua boca se governará todo o meu povo, somente no trono eu serei maior que tu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף רְאֵה֙ נָתַ֣תִּי אֹֽתְךָ֔ עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·ṯə·ḵā ‘al kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Pharaoh also told . . . Joseph I hereby place you over all the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Disse mais Faraó a José: Vês aqui te tenho posto sobre toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨סַר פַּרְעֹ֤ה אֶת־ טַבַּעְתּוֹ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יָד֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֖הּ עַל־ יַ֣ד יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְדֵי־ שֵׁ֔שׁ וַיָּ֛שֶׂם רְבִ֥ד הַזָּהָ֖ב עַל־ צַוָּארֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·sar par·‘ōh ’eṯ- ṭab·ba‘·tōw mê·‘al yā·ḏōw way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯāh ‘al- yaḏ yō·w·sêp̄ way·yal·bêš ’ō·ṯōw biḡ·ḏê- šêš way·yā·śem rə·ḇiḏ haz·zā·hāḇ ‘al- ṣaw·wā·rōw
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh removed the signet ring from his finger put it on Joseph’s finger clothed him in garments of fine linen and placed a gold chain around his neck
verses.literalPt: E tirou Faraó o anel da sua mão, e o pôs na mão de José, e o fez vestir de roupas de linho fino, e pôs um colar de ouro no seu pescoço.

verses.original: וַיַּרְכֵּ֣ב אֹת֗וֹ בְּמִרְכֶּ֤בֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֔וֹ וַיִּקְרְא֥וּ לְפָנָ֖יו אַבְרֵ֑ךְ וְנָת֣וֹן אֹת֔וֹ עַ֖ל כָּל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·kêḇ ’ō·ṯōw bə·mir·ke·ḇeṯ ham·miš·neh ’ă·šer- lōw way·yiq·rə·’ū lə·p̄ā·nāw ’aḇ·rêḵ wə·nā·ṯō·wn ’ō·ṯōw ‘al kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: He had Joseph ride in his second - chariot with men calling out before him Bow the knee So he placed him over all the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E o fez subir no segundo carro que tinha, e clamavam diante dele: Ajoelhai. Assim o pôs sobre toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֛ה אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲנִ֣י פַרְעֹ֑ה וּבִלְעָדֶ֗יךָ לֹֽא־ יָרִ֨ים אִ֧ישׁ אֶת־ יָד֛וֹ וְאֶת־ רַגְל֖וֹ בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer par·‘ōh ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·nî p̄ar·‘ōh ū·ḇil·‘ā·ḏe·ḵā lō- yā·rîm ’îš ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw wə·’eṯ- raḡ·lōw bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And Pharaoh declared to Joseph I am Pharaoh but without your permission no one in all the land of Egypt shall lift his hand or foot
verses.literalPt: E disse Faraó a José: Eu sou Faraó; porém sem ti ninguém levantará a sua mão ou o seu pé em toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֣ה שֵׁם־ יוֹסֵף֮ צָֽפְנַ֣ת פַּעְנֵחַ֒ וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֣וֹ אֶת־ אָֽסְנַ֗ת בַּת־ פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֛רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֹ֖ן לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וַיֵּצֵ֥א יוֹסֵ֖ף עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā p̄ar·‘ōh šêm- yō·w·sêp̄ ṣā·p̄ə·naṯ pa‘·nê·aḥ way·yit·ten- lōw ’eṯ- ’ā·sə·naṯ baṯ- pō·w·ṭî p̄e·ra‘ kō·hên ’ōn lə·’iš·šāh way·yê·ṣê yō·w·sêp̄ ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-paneah and he gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera priest of On to be his wife And Joseph took charge of all the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E Faraó chamou a José de Zafenate-Panéia, e deu-lhe por mulher a Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om; e saiu José por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְיוֹסֵף֙ בֶּן־ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעָמְד֕וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹסֵף֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַֽיַּעְבֹ֖ר בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·sêp̄ ben- šə·lō·šîm šā·nāh bə·‘ā·mə·ḏōw lip̄·nê par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·rā·yim way·yê·ṣê yō·w·sêp̄ mil·lip̄·nê p̄ar·‘ōh way·yaʿ·ḇōr bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now Joseph was thirty years old . . . when he entered the service . . . of Pharaoh king of Egypt And Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E José era da idade de trinta anos quando se apresentou a Faraó, rei do Egito. E saiu José da presença de Faraó e passou por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַתַּ֣עַשׂ הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע לִקְמָצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘aś hā·’ā·reṣ bə·še·ḇa‘ šə·nê haś·śā·ḇā‘ liq·mā·ṣîm
verses.literal: During the seven years of abundance the land brought forth bountifully
verses.literalPt: E nos sete anos de fartura a terra produziu abundantemente. 48 E ele ajuntou todo o mantimento dos sete anos, que houve na terra do Egito; e guardou o mantimento nas cidades, pondo nas mesmas o mantimento do campo que estava ao redor de cada cidade.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבֹּ֞ץ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹ֣כֶל׀ שֶׁ֣בַע שָׁנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּתֶּן־ אֹ֖כֶל בֶּעָרִ֑ים אֹ֧כֶל שְׂדֵה־ הָעִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתֶ֖יהָ נָתַ֥ן בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bōṣ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ō·ḵel še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm ’ă·šer hā·yū bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yit·ten- ’ō·ḵel be·‘ā·rîm ’ō·ḵel śə·ḏêh- hā·‘îr ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·ṯe·hā nā·ṯan bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: During those seven years Joseph collected all the excess food in the land of Egypt - and stored it in the cities In every city he laid up the food from the fields around it
verses.literalPt: Verszeile ohne Text

verses.original: וַיִּצְבֹּ֨ר יוֹסֵ֥ף בָּ֛ר כְּח֥וֹל הַיָּ֖ם הַרְבֵּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד עַ֛ד כִּי־ חָדַ֥ל לִסְפֹּ֖ר כִּי־ אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·bōr yō·w·sêp̄ bār kə·ḥō·wl hay·yām har·bêh mə·’ōḏ ‘aḏ kî- ḥā·ḏal lis·pōr kî- ’ên mis·pār
verses.literal: So Joseph stored up grain in such abundance . . . . . . like the sand of the sea that he stopped keeping track of it for it was beyond measure
verses.literalPt: Assim ajuntou José muitíssimo trigo, como a areia do mar, até que cessou de contar; porquanto não havia numeração.

verses.original: וּלְיוֹסֵ֤ף יֻלַּד֙ שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא שְׁנַ֣ת הָרָעָ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָֽלְדָה־ לּוֹ֙ אָֽסְנַ֔ת בַּת־ פּ֥וֹטִי פֶ֖רַע כֹּהֵ֥ן אֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·yō·w·sêp̄ yul·laḏ šə·nê ḇā·nîm bə·ṭe·rem tā·ḇō·w šə·naṯ hā·rā·‘āḇ ’ă·šer yā·lə·ḏāh- lōw ’ā·sə·naṯ baṯ- pō·w·ṭî p̄e·ra‘ kō·hên ’ō·wn
verses.literal: Before the years of famine arrived two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera priest of On
verses.literalPt: E nasceram a José dois filhos (antes que viesse um ano de fome), que lhe deu Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם הַבְּכ֖וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כִּֽי־ נַשַּׁ֤נִי אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲמָלִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- šêm hab·bə·ḵō·wr mə·naš·šeh kî- naš·ša·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·mā·lî wə·’êṯ kāl- bêṯ ’ā·ḇî
verses.literal: Joseph named . . . the firstborn Manasseh saying God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s household
verses.literalPt: E chamou José ao primogênito Manassés, porque disse: Deus me fez esquecer de todo o meu trabalho, e de toda a casa de meu pai.

verses.original: וְאֵ֛ת שֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖י קָרָ֣א אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־ הִפְרַ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ עָנְיִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šêm haš·šê·nî qā·rā ’ep̄·rā·yim kî- hip̄·ra·nî ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·’e·reṣ ‘ā·nə·yî
verses.literal: And the second son he named . . . Ephraim saying God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction
verses.literalPt: E ao segundo chamou Efraim; porque disse: Deus me fez crescer na terra da minha aflição.

verses.original: וַתִּכְלֶ֕ינָה שֶׁ֖בַע שְׁנֵ֣י הַשָּׂבָ֑ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḵ·le·nāh še·ḇa‘ šə·nê haś·śā·ḇā‘ ’ă·šer hā·yāh bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When the seven years of abundance - in the land of Egypt came to an end
verses.literalPt: Então acabaram-se os sete anos de fartura que havia na terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַתְּחִלֶּ֜ינָה שֶׁ֣בַע שְׁנֵ֤י הָרָעָב֙ לָב֔וֹא כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר יוֹסֵ֑ף וַיְהִ֤י רָעָב֙ בְּכָל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וּבְכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם הָ֥יָה לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tə·ḥil·le·nāh še·ḇa‘ šə·nê hā·rā·‘āḇ lā·ḇō·w ka·’ă·šer ’ā·mar yō·w·sêp̄ way·hî rā·‘āḇ bə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ū·ḇə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim hā·yāh lā·ḥem
verses.literal: the seven years of famine . . . began just as Joseph had said And although there was famine in every country there was food throughout the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: E começaram a vir os sete anos de fome, como José tinha dito; e havia fome em todas as terras, mas em toda a terra do Egito havia pão.

verses.original: וַתִּרְעַב֙ כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיִּצְעַ֥ק הָעָ֛ם אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה לַלָּ֑חֶם וַיֹּ֨אמֶר פַּרְעֹ֤ה לְכָל־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לְכ֣וּ אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֔ף אֲשֶׁר־ יֹאמַ֥ר לָכֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tir·‘aḇ kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yiṣ·‘aq hā·‘ām ’el- par·‘ōh lal·lā·ḥem way·yō·mer par·‘ōh lə·ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim lə·ḵū ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·šer- yō·mar lā·ḵem ta·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: When extreme hunger came to all the land of Egypt and the people cried out to Pharaoh for food he told all the Egyptians Go to Joseph and do whatever he tells you
verses.literalPt: E tendo toda a terra do Egito fome, clamou o povo a Faraó por pão; e Faraó disse a todos os egípcios: Ide a José; o que ele vos disser, fazei.

verses.original: וְהָרָעָ֣ב הָיָ֔ה עַ֖ל כָּל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶֽת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֣ר לְמִצְרַ֔יִם וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָֽרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·rā·‘āḇ hā·yāh ‘al kāl- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ way·yip̄·taḥ yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer bā·hem way·yiš·bōr lə·miṣ·ra·yim way·ye·ḥĕ·zaq hā·rā·‘āḇ bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: When the famine had spread over all the land Joseph opened up all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Havendo, pois, fome sobre toda a terra, abriu José tudo em que havia mantimento, e vendeu aos egípcios; porque a fome prevaleceu na terra do Egito.

verses.original: וְכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר אֶל־ יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּֽי־ חָזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ bā·’ū miṣ·ray·māh liš·bōr ’el- yō·w·sêp̄ kî- ḥā·zaq hā·rā·‘āḇ bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And every nation came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain because the famine was severe over all the earth
verses.literalPt: E de todas as terras vinham ao Egito, para comprar de José; porquanto a fome prevaleceu em todas as terras.
